name: Our Execution [V7.8a.0: Medical Aid & More]
desc:
V7.8a.0 [Medical Aid & More]

-- CONSOLE SUPPORT IS SUPPORTED

Our Execution is a game set in a fictional world based on the mid to late 19th Century. 
A mysterious disease would emerge, slowly spreading from the mines to the rest of the world. Puppeteering the bodies of its victims, it would become a whole new threat the world hadn't prepared for. You are a soldier, forced to join forces with former enemies to fight your way out and, hopefully, survive another day.
